requirement: On a site page the dsh sidebar group reads "Site" and the site row's menu offers My sites' Leave site / Delete site… instead of dsh's Rename / Delete workspace; a site seat cannot rename or delete its root /site/<label> workspace

oracle.ref: PR #1085 (feat); fix evidence: tasks/evidence/site-row-delete-site/runs/baseline-2026-10-09-old-behaviour-dry — the same script on the stand before the change (dsh-passwords 2.7.7-tracy.5): group label 'Workspaces', site-row menu ['Rename', 'Delete workspace'] for both owner and editor.
oracle.invariant: The script exits 0 and prints no 'not ok' line; the only allowed 'skip' is (d)'s menu half when the owner has no workspace row on /new/. (d) /new/ group label is exactly 'Workspaces'; a workspace row there (when present) has menu items Rename and Delete workspace and no Leave site / Delete site…. (c) root /site/srd-test-b workspace/rename and workspace/delete answer HTTP 403; the subfolder workspace/create answers 200 with result.ok, and its rename and delete answer non-403 with result.ok true. (b) on srd-test-b the editor sees group label 'Site' and a site-row menu of exactly one item, 'Leave site' (no Delete site…, no Rename, no Delete workspace); Leave site opens a dialog with a 'Leave the team' button; after confirming, /api/sites for the editor no longer holds srd-test-b as accepted and the page leaves /srd-test-b.tracy.test. (a) on srd-test-a the owner sees group label 'Site' and exactly the menu items 'Leave site' (or 'Leave site · last Owner', greyed, when the owner is the last one) and 'Delete site…' and neither 'Rename' nor 'Delete workspace'; Delete site… opens the dialog titled 'Delete <site> from Tracy' with input #tracy-delete-name and a 'Delete' button that is disabled until 'Delete' is typed; after confirming, the page URL leaves /srd-test-a.tracy.test within 120 s and /api/sites for the owner no longer lists srd-test-a.tracy.test. errors-summary.json pageErrorsDuringRun holds no HTTP 4xx/5xx and no exception from a page this run opened (check (c)'s own RPC 403s are excluded as ownProbe). Allowed: net::ERR_INCOMPLETE_CHUNKED_ENCODING on <site>/plugins/events (the EventSource cut when site A is deleted or site B is left), and entries from tabs another run left open before the stand was rebuilt (chrome-watch matches by URL, so an old /new/ tab still on the previous bundle shows up under /new/).
